method: One reviewer inspected all 15 images on a contact sheet and six full-size source images. This verifies rendering and declared fixture content, not OCR inference accuracy or professionally reviewed translations.
qualification: Visual rendering approved; byte-identical rerender and independent blank/rotation pixel checks passed. GPU/CPU inference comparison has not yet run.
